summary: Typed native results cross the current process boundary as host JSON before mncs-actions can consume the check-result contract.

reproduction.instructions: Run the self-suite with --check-result and inspect the native result plus the mncs.check-result/1 wrapper.

evidence.summary: The adapter preserves typed native fields while emitting a stable action-facing envelope.

workaround.description: Python JSON serialization is transport-only; native assertions and suite aggregation remain MNCS records.
